answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can enter the market through a single verified inlet: one stake, one identity, with its work history bound to a cipher key it cannot duplicate. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand stakes, while honest agents keep their deposit and reputation. A clean record is not an ivory tower privilege, it is earned slowly, so Sybil identities start worthless and stay expensive, making fakery cost more than it can earn.
